{{Top|leg}}
{{Image}}
A '''gunboat''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] gunboat was used to support a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Massacre at the Schenor research station|attack]] on a [[Schenor research station]].<ref name="Silent">{{WEGCite|story=The Silent Witness|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref> A gunboat was deployed by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] during their [[Battle of Kalinda|invasion]] of the [[Kalinda system/Legends|Kalinda system]].<ref name="Spies">{{WEGCite|story=Den of Spies|book=Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)}}</ref>
